overview:
A must-see for fans: a database software featuring the full lineup of "Formula Nippon" race queens

Race Queen F

Rapidly rising race queens appear! The first volume is Formula Nippon!!

This data edition of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book and database of race queens from Formula Nippon. Browse their photos and short movies, read each woman's profile, and search the lineup by details such as team, birthday, height, blood type, measurements and hometown.

- Photo Hall: photo albums
- Video Hall: short movies
- Information Hall: cast profiles and photos with a search function
- Bonus: a collection of answering machine messages
